test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following autobiographies was written by the Indian female poet Kamala Das, who was nominated for Nobel Prize for literature in 1984?

options.text: Smritichitre: The Memoire of a Spirited Wife

solution:
The correct answer is __**My Story**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"My Story" **is a candid and introspective **autobiography** penned by the renowned **Indian poet and author Kamala Das**, also known as **Kamala Surayya**.
 
• Published in **1976,** **Kamala Das's autobiography **provides a deeply personal account of her lif**e experiences, struggles, and literary journey.**
 
• The autobiography spans her **childhood, marriage, and relationships**, offering insights into various aspects of her life.
 
• **Kamala Das's nomination** for the **Nobel Prize** for **Literature in 1984 **further underscores the significance of her autobiographical work and her impact on the literary landscape.
 
• The autobiography explores themes such as **gender, identity, societal expectations, love, desire, and spirituality**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A Life Less Ordinary**

 
 
• **Baby Halder** is the author of the book - “**A Life Less Ordinary**”.
 
• This book is a **translation** of her book named** Aalo Aandhari**.
 
 
 
• **A Life Apart**
 
 
• **Author Neel Mukherjee** was born in **Calcutta**.
 
• His first novel, **A Life Apart**, won the **Writers’ Guild of Great Britain Award **for **best fiction**.
 
• His second novel, The **Lives of Others**, was shortlisted for the **Man Booker Prize** and **won the Encore Prize**.
 
 
 
• **Smritichitre: The Memoire of a Spirited Wife**
 
 
• **Lakshmi Bai Tilak** (1868–1936) was a **Marathi writer, best known for her memoir, Smritichitre**.
 
• She also completed her husband, **Narayan Waman Tilak’s**, epic poem **Chirstayana** after his death.
